control.label: UI direction
control.type: single-select radio cards with labelled style sample

authority.enforcement: Existing exact workspace/gym/record/action/field and individual deny rules; authorise each actual action separately. Owner has own-company baseline; delegated roles need matching rights. No cross-tenant or global platform restyling.

scope.company: Published default for all company portals/modules and company-owned public pages, inherited by each gym
scope.gym: Company-approved overrides of style/brand tokens only in actual gym scope; reset removes override and re-inherits
scope.personal: Light/dark/system and reduced motion/effects only; does not publish a shared preset
scope.platform: Platform admin console and Orb Gym platform marketing page retain platform configuration; a tenant cannot alter another workspace or platform identity

documents.new_outputs: Use approved brand identity and template version, with readable print-safe surfaces
documents.issued_outputs: Freeze original brand/template/data snapshot; no retrospective restyling
documents.effects: No live blur/translucent/embossed controls on receipts, invoices, signed records or print exports

accessibility.effects_preference: auto | full | reduced; personal preference and OS settings can reduce effects, never overridden by company decoration
accessibility.effective_reduction: Reduced transparency, forced colours or reduced effects remove blur/decorative depth; reduced motion stops decorative animation; system or personal reduction wins over full
accessibility.contrast_requirement: Normal text at least 4.5:1, large text 3:1, meaningful controls/focus at least 3:1 against adjacent surfaces; verify actual composite backgrounds and user colours, not only base tokens.

recovery.stale: This appearance has changed. Review the latest version before publishing. Preserve draft for compare/rebase; no silent overwrite.
recovery.failure: Could not publish appearance. Your draft is saved; the current appearance remains active.
recovery.unavailable_effect: Use resolved solid fallback and preserve content and current selection; no essential feature depends on blur/shadow support.
recovery.invalid_preset: Reject invalid publication; render last valid snapshot or inherited Basic 01 and report configuration fault without granting additional access.
